about: S-ma - the Ma page (TodayPage at /, design round B frames lifeos/ma-1..ma-4) and its undrawn states. Account M = user@tracker.local. Written by make-states.mjs (edit that file, not this one). GET /lifeos/today is the B-core recording; its Phase-3 keys habits / tasks are fixture additions (no 032 recording yet), schema-checked by fixture-schema-check.mjs against lib/lifeos-api.ts. Nothing is written live: every tap of the frames is a capture of a still state.

ma-1.title: Ma — edzésnap (a keret)
ma-1.why: the frame day (Monday 19 October): no session running, the plan day "Felsőtest – húzás", 4 habits and 6 tasks of the README-ma seed. GET /lifeos/today carries no habits / tasks on the running backend (no migration 032), so they are fixture keys: matched-fixture at best

ma-2.title: Ma — pihenőnap, minden kész
ma-2.why: the rest day after ma-1: 3 good habits done, 2 bad habits clean, the 2 Tuesday tasks done, tomorrow "Alsótest – guggolás 18:00" from the week window. The daily challenge (Phase 4) is not on Ma yet, so "Ma eddig" lacks its +15 and the NAPI DOBÁS block is not drawn

ma-3.title: Ma — új felhasználó
ma-3.why: a brand-new member: 0 coins, level 0, only the onboarding plan's workout ("Teljes test – alap"); no habits, no tasks — the two empty sections. The frame's pay lines under the empty states quote the admin rules and are not drawn

ma-4.title: Ma — szerda reggel, még semmi kész
ma-4.why: the frame's day without its subject: the pending daily draw (NAPI DOBÁS above MAI EDZÉS) is Phase 4 and cannot be reached; every other block (hero 0/7, the Wednesday workout, 5 habits, 3 tasks) is drawn. Ma then continues with TÁPLÁLKOZÁS and the library row, which the frame crops

due.title: Felhívni a szerelőt a kazán miatt

ma-relapse-sheet.title: Ma — visszaesés megerősítése
ma-relapse-sheet.why: a bad habit's row asks before it logs a relapse (it costs coins and ends the streak; f_app confirms it too): the kit ConfirmSheet over Ma

ma-capture-sheet.title: Ma — Rögzítés: a gyors rögzítés lapja Ma fölött
ma-capture-sheet.why: FELADATOK "+ Rögzítés" opens the S-tasks capture sheet (frame lifeos/capture) over Ma (request R-S-ma-02, applied in the fix round). The sheet reads GET /tasks for the logical today: an empty TasksResponse, schema-checked like the rest

ma-habit-sheet.title: Ma — Első szokás: az új szokás lapja Ma fölött
ma-habit-sheet.why: SZOKÁSOK "+ Első szokás" opens the S-habits new-habit sheet (frame lifeos/habit-form) over Ma in one tap (fix round; it was a door to the Szokások list)

ma-failed.title: Ma — a LifeOS-olvasás nem sikerült
ma-failed.why: GET /lifeos/today answers 500: the ledger line and the hero print the dash, "Újra" under the hero; the session, the food and the library row still work

ma-live-session.title: Ma — futó edzés (Folytatás)
ma-live-session.why: the seed leaves user@ mid-session: MAI EDZÉS shows the running session with "Folytatás"; GET /lifeos/today as recorded from the B-core backend (no habits / tasks yet), so SZOKÁSOK / FELADATOK are not drawn and the hero counts the workout alone
